why: Apothecary row has no mark yet says medicines are 'brought from abroad'; the siege stops all trade by road, gate and water.
Bowyers 'supplying ... the caravans' unmarked; the siege has stopped caravans and road trade.
Daily markets row offers bare Fresh produce; Services tab marks the same service Impaired, and famine has grown 7% of need.
Claims herbs and medicines 'all to be had' unmarked; LAND has wild foraging depleted, herbs imported, herbalism chain vulnerable, siege stops imports.
Plural 'Banking houses' with singular verb 'is'; subject and verb do not agree.
Mercenary and adventuring flows are 'Operational' with output Armed escort, while Institutions and Services print Armed escort as stopped by the siege.
Entertainment & cultural tourism export flow printed Operational under siege; siege stops all trade and arrivals, and C6144 says no outward trade can reach a buyer.
Medicinal herbs shown 'Fully exploited' drawing on herb gathering areas; LAND gives Wild Foraging Areas depleted, and C6323 says little is left to take.
Acceptance word 'hostile' names nothing it is hostile toward; the town has a wizard's tower, enchanter and scroll scribe and a powerful religious authority with no stated quarrel with magic.
Sawyer 'tells you which timber is good this year'; LAND gap says no timber reaches the sawmill and the siege cuts the roads.
Fishmonger haggles and drops the price for repeat bulk buyers; the fish market is stopped by the siege and the famine leaves no food to spare.
Customs collector 'names the duty, takes the coin'; the customs house is stopped by the siege (duties stopped, no goods enter or leave).
